TECHNOLOGY.EFFECTIVE_SPECIFICATION: Only ISSUE32 is normative. Past approvals remain in Git history.

ISSUE32_TECHNOLOGY_REVISION.SCOPE: Reuse the already approved Go net/http, PostgreSQL, pgx, goose, embedded Centrifuge, and BFE Drive Internal Auth UDS infrastructure; no new dependencies. Historical approvals are retained within their original scope.
ISSUE32_TECHNOLOGY_REVISION.DECISION: Use existing native net/http routing to expose the unversioned /conversations resource tree. No external API version router, rewriting facade or duplicated handler stack is required in the target.

Reuse existing BFE Drive Internal Auth UDS verification and DPoP proof/request-binding validation; never introduce plain Bearer fallback. Preserve Centrifuge connection and subscription authorization.
Reuse existing functional /v2 conversation code as the production migration starting point only after upstream approval; do not fork/rebuild equivalent direct and group semantics.

No data migration, production-data inspection, or new dependencies. Identify and later remove obsolete legacy schema definitions using existing PostgreSQL/goose mechanisms under separate implementation approval; never execute destructive production database operations by this proposal.
